name: core-vlm-theory-v5-russian-sedimentology
purpose: Russian text-only sedimentology knowledge; no image labels or facies ground truth

candidate.note: Initial rank-8 run failed before first optimizer step because CUDA memory allocation failed. Rank-4 retry completed.

evaluation.method: Manual qualitative review of 24 held-out Russian text questions; no claim of numeric accuracy or photographic performance
observed_failures: Conglomerate versus breccia answer omits dominant clast roundness and invents 'deep minerals' as a diagnostic feature.
Shale versus mudstone answer misses fissility and invents a primarily compositional contrast.
Carbonate mudstone answer invents high acidity, temperature and oxygen conditions.
Coal versus carbonaceous mudrock answer invents 'coal minerals' such as coal silicon and coal magnesium.
The 0.055 mm grain-size question fails to identify 0.05 versus 0.063 mm classification boundaries.
Several answers reach the generation limit without completing the diagnostic explanation.
evaluation.conclusion: The new LoRA does not materially correct the base model's factual failures. Training loss is not an accuracy measure.

application_decision: Do not activate this theory adapter. Keep visual adapter for photo work; answer close theory questions from local source-attributed v5 cards, and use retrieval for broader questions.
